results.title: Language Assistant Program Spain 2026 2027
results.content:
housing, Indian in Spain, Sneh in spain, move abroad, europe life, nomad life, explore page [...] . . . #spanishlife #learnspanish #learningspanish #languagelearning #movingabroad [...] Everyone assumes you have to move abroad to become fluent in a language.
 ✈️ New country means fluency, right?
But I’m proof that’s not true.

When I started my Applied Linguistics degree (Spanish with Italian), I didn’t know any Spanish nor Italian.❌ 
From week one, most of my classes — literature, culture, speaking, reading — were taught entirely in Spanish or Italian.
Imagine walking into your first class and realising your native language (Polish, in my case 🇵🇱) wasn’t allowed.
